Dear ImGui, docking branch, v1.92.9b
Source: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui (branch: docking)
License: MIT (see LICENSE.txt in this folder)

Vendored for zio_editor only (tools/zio_editor/) - not a dependency of the
zio engine itself (sdk/, src/, include/) or of any game created via
"zio new". See tools/zio_editor/CMakeLists.txt.

Files: imgui.h/.cpp, imgui_internal.h, imgui_draw.cpp, imgui_tables.cpp,
imgui_widgets.cpp, imstb_*.h, imconfig.h, plus backends/imgui_impl_win32.*
(docking branch adds ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable/DockSpace - not present
on ImGui's master branch).

Two renderer backends, one compiled per build depending on which SDK
tools/zio_editor points at (see its CMakeLists.txt's ZIO_EDITOR_SDK_DIR /
ZIO_RENDER_BACKEND branch) - imgui_impl_win32.* (platform/input) is shared
by both:
  - backends/imgui_impl_dx11.* for a D3D11-backend SDK.
  - backends/imgui_impl_vulkan.* for a VULKAN-backend SDK. Pulled from the
    same v1.92.9b tag as everything else here, so its API (ImGui_ImplVulkan_
    InitInfo's PipelineInfoMain, in particular) matches this exact ImGui
    version.
